normalization.whitespace: trim outer whitespace; preserve internal whitespace

name_sources.relationship: first name element text; when a mutation creates a relationship with no name, the name source is '{source identifier}->{target identifier}'
name_sources.organization_item: first label element text; type is folder
name_sources.property_definition: first name element text; type is the propertyDefinition type attribute

collision: If distinct objects normalize to the same identity, append -2, -3, ... in stable document order; reapplication of the same identity reuses the original identifier. A mutation that would re-allocate the bare identifier to a different object is reported, not silently re-hashed.
